hero.h1: Faucet and Fixture Installation and Repair in Geneva, IL
hero.sub: A dripping faucet in a 100-year-old bathroom, a new kitchen faucet for a remodel or a full set of fixtures for a basement bath. We repair and install faucets and fixtures across Geneva, with a flat price you approve first. From our office on Campbell Street.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in branded red leather gloves installing a new chrome faucet on a white bathroom sink with an adjustable wrench

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

tiles.h3: It Drips After You Turn It Off
tiles.body: A worn cartridge, washer or seal.
A supply line, shutoff or drain connection.
A clogged aerator, a worn cartridge or old pipe behind the wall.

tiles.h3: The Handle Is Loose or Stiff
tiles.body: Worn parts inside. Old faucets may need replacement if parts aren't made.

bodies: We fix and install kitchen faucets of every kind, from classic bridge faucets that suit an older home to pull-downs, touchless models and drinking water taps.
In older Geneva homes, the shutoffs and supply lines under the sink may be decades old. We check and replace them as part of the install when needed, so the new faucet starts on solid connections.
We handle sink drains, dishwasher hookups, refrigerator and ice maker lines, disposals and gas lines for ranges, plus new layouts for kitchen remodels in homes old and new.

Clogged sink? See [drain cleaning](/geneva/drain-cleaning). Disposal trouble? See [garbage disposal repair](/geneva/garbage-disposal-installation-repair). Want a drinking water filter? See [water filtration](/geneva/water-filtration-systems).

img.alt: Plumbing under a double kitchen sink: white PVC drain and P-trap, braided supply lines with chrome shutoff valves, and a garbage disposal

bodies: We install sinks, faucets, toilets, showerheads, tub fillers, laundry tubs and outdoor spigots, from a single swap to a full bathroom. Every install includes the connections, new shutoffs where needed and a leak check.

Restoring a period bathroom? We can install reproduction fixtures and work with existing ones where possible. For toilets, see [toilet installation](/geneva/toilet-installation-repair). For showers, see [shower repair](/geneva/shower-repair).

blocks.h2: Faucets and Fixtures in Geneva Homes
blocks.intro: Fixture work in Geneva ranges from preservation to modern upgrades.

items.body: Some historic homes have original sinks and tubs. We repair the plumbing around them instead of replacing them when we can.
Older sinks often have hole spacing modern faucets don't match. We'll help find one that fits.
In homes built after 1990, original faucets tend to wear out together.

blocks.h2: Faucet and Fixture Questions From Geneva Homeowners

items.q: Can you repair an original faucet in an older home?
items.answer: Often, yes. If parts are available, we rebuild it. If not, we'll help you find a replacement that suits the house.

items.q: Can you install a faucet I bought?
items.preview: Yes. Send us the make and model.
items.answer: Yes. Send us the make and model and we'll confirm it fits your sink and plumbing.

items.q: Why is the flow weak from my bathroom faucet?
items.preview: A clogged aerator, worn cartridge or old pipe.
items.answer: Start with the aerator. If that doesn't help, it may be the cartridge or, in an older home, galvanized pipe behind the wall.

items.q: Should I repair or replace my faucet?
items.preview: Repair good faucets. Replace failing ones.
items.answer: Repair a quality faucet with a worn part. Replace one that's corroded or has no parts available.

items.q: How much does faucet installation cost in Geneva?
items.preview: It depends on the faucet and valves. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the faucet, the shutoffs and supply lines and access. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
